name: Cindy's Lei Shoppe
usual_products: Pīkake; Pakalana; Maile; Tuberose; Orchid; Plumeria; Carnation; Ginger; Hala; Rose (lokelani); Ti leaf; Haku / head lei; Money lei
notes: Family business since 1959, voted Star-Advertiser best lei stand 12 of last 13 years. Curbside pickup: call from Maunakea and Beretania and they bring the order out. Ships fresh lei to all 50 states.
